Plastic Granules: Plastic granules for plastic packaging solutions
Textile Auxiliaries: Cationic, non-ionic, surfactant and amphoteric auxiliaries for dyeing, printing, finishing and sizing

risks.note: Management flags that compliance with increasingly strict pollution control norms can lead to higher operational costs and capital investment in ETPs/ZLD, and that non-compliance can result in plant shutdowns, fines or loss of reputation. The Company's own short-term roadmap includes establishing or enhancing effluent treatment facilities, which indicates the exposure is live rather than theoretical.
risks.risk: Stringent environmental regulation on a dyes and chemicals operation

risks.note: Heavy reliance on petrochemical-based inputs makes the industry vulnerable to global oil price fluctuations and supply disruptions - a direct pass-through risk to gross margin for a formulator that buys basic auxiliaries and blends them.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility through petrochemical-linked inputs

risks.note: Both domestic and international players, including Chinese suppliers with lower cost structures, contribute to pricing pressure and margin erosion. The Company itself states its products 'compete with the market on the price range', so differentiation rests on formulation and service rather than price.
risks.risk: Intense competition and pricing pressure, including from low-cost Chinese suppliers

risks.note: Larger textile customers are increasingly negotiating aggressive pricing or switching to vertically integrated suppliers, reducing leverage for chemical manufacturers. The Company sells into processing houses and depends on repeat orders from that same buyer set.
risks.risk: Customer consolidation and buyer bargaining power

risks.note: Failure to upgrade technology or adapt to new environmental standards may result in loss of market share or regulatory action - relevant as the market shifts to eco-friendly, fluorine-free, bio-based and low-VOC chemistries, which the Company has only stated as an intent to develop.

Recessionary trends, inflation or geopolitical disruptions may impact textile exports and thereby indirectly affect chemical demand. The Company is a single-end-market supplier - its stated revenue for FY2025-26 is entirely from Textile Chemicals & Auxiliaries - so a textile downturn transmits directly.
risks.risk: End-market concentration on the textile cycle and global economic uncertainty

risks.note: Handling of hazardous chemicals involves risks to worker safety and potential liabilities in the case of accidents or regulatory lapses; the roadmap accordingly commits to stricter occupational health and safety practices at all sites.
risks.risk: Health, safety and liability exposure from handling hazardous chemicals

risks.note: For exporters and importers of raw materials, forex volatility can significantly affect cost structures and profitability.
risks.risk: Currency fluctuation on imported inputs and export realisations
